goal.text: The visitor services lead gets a checked list of duty swaps on Thursdays, so every gallery has a steward who knows its evacuation route.
cites: [A:A01 "so every gallery has a steward who knows its evacuation route"]

agent_checkable.metric: Approved swaps whose taker lacks the duty's training
agent_checkable.check: A script compares each approved row's taker with the training list (Q01).
cites: [A:A01 "Q01 the volunteer taking a duty holds the training it needs (blocker)."]

agent_checkable.metric: Rows that quote their swap message
agent_checkable.check: A script finds each quoted message word for word in the input (Q03).

outcome.metric: Galleries covered by a steward without its fire walk
cites: [A:A01 "No gallery covered without its fire walk in a season."]

outcome.metric: Swap e-mails answered by the following Thursday
cites: [A:A01 "Every swap e-mail is answered by the Thursday after it arrives."]

users_and_stakeholders.interest: Check which duties they now have.
cites: [A:A01 "Gallery stewards (users: check which duties they now have)."]
[A:A01 "Visitor services lead (approver: approves the list on Thursdays)."]

steps: The lead checks the training table in the steward handbook.
The lead edits the weekend sheet.
problems: One Sunday the upper gallery was covered by a steward who hadn't done its fire walk.
The training table in the handbook and the weekend sheet disagree about who is trained.
cites: [A:A01 "one Sunday the upper gallery was covered by a steward who hadn't done its fire walk"]

in: A checked list of swaps out.
cites: [A:A01 "Out: school group bookings, volunteer recruitment, the café rota."]

inputs.format: plain text, one swap per message

samples.description: A made-up week of swap messages.
A made-up training list: each volunteer's role and fire walks.

cites: [S:S01 §whole file]
[S:S03 §whole file]

glossary.meaning: The walk-through of a gallery's evacuation route that a steward must do before covering it.

acceptance_tests.words: I give it a month of made-up swap e-mails, and no gallery ever goes to a steward without its fire walk.
cites: [A:A01 "I give it a month of made-up swap e-mails, and no gallery ever goes to a steward without its fire walk."]

context_inventory.evidence_for: each volunteer's role and fire walks

cites: [A:A01 "Public: the handbook is published on the museum's website"]

ranks.what: The visitor services lead's own decisions
Reference documents in the context pack
Official documentation on the maker's own site

confidence.high: The row quotes the swap message and the training list entry that decided it.
confidence.medium: A reputable secondary source; not expected here.
confidence.low: Inferred or one weak source; such a swap is refused and raised as a question.

conflicts: The higher rank wins within its own area.
A conflict the ranks do not settle is reported with both citations, never decided silently.

output.description: One row per swap message, with a decision: approve or refuse. An e-mail that names no gallery is refused as incomplete.
output.format: Table, one row per swap message
cites: [A:A01 "An e-mail that names no gallery is refused as incomplete."]

rules.statement: The volunteer taking a duty holds the training it needs.
cites: [A:A01 "Q01 the volunteer taking a duty holds the training it needs (blocker)."]

rules.statement: A swap is only between two volunteers in the same role.
cites: [A:A01 "Q02 a swap is only between two volunteers in the same role (major)."]

rules.statement: Every row quotes the swap message.
cites: [A:A01 "Q03 every row quotes the swap message (major)."]
[A:A01 "Q04 the reason is one sentence (minor)."]

good.text: Sat am | Upper gallery | Ida to Jem | approve | Jem has done its fire walk
Sun pm | Mill room | Kai to Lou | approve | Lou has done its fire walk

bad.text: Sun am | Upper gallery | Mo to Nat | approve
bad.why: Nat has not done the upper gallery fire walk.

bad.text: Sat pm | Mill room | Oz (steward) to Pip (shop) | approve
bad.why: Pip works in the shop, not as a steward.

risk.notes: A wrong swap can be fixed before the weekend, not during an evacuation. Stewards and visitors are affected.
cites: [A:A01 "Partly reversible"]
[A:A02 "About forty stewards, and visitors if there is ever an evacuation."]
[A:A01 "Reads the swap messages."]

cites: [A:A01 "I approve the list on Thursday before the weekend sheet changes."]
